text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Haaaahhh!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: K-Khhh, OOOOOOHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Oguri Cap crosses the finish line!!
Emerging victorious from this heart-wrenching, breathtaking battle is none other than Oguri Cap!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible race...!
This Mainichi Okan will go down in history without a doubt...!!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text: This is all thanks to you, Inari One...! You truly are the presence needed right now, in this era where Oguri Cap and the others shine so brilliantly...!
(Wooooo--!!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you're really amazing...!!
To run a race like that against someone
called the center of the era...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Damn it... dammit, dammit, dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I lost...!
I was completely and utterly beaten...!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I really shouldn't have lost...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri is the strongest!!
She's so freakin' amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
“Do your best in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) too—!!
I'll definitely be there cheering for you—!!”
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (So huge... What a massive back...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate...
I'm gonna—"

On the way back from the racetrack,
a heavy look still lingered on Inari One's face...
As I struggled to find the right words to say—

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
—Inari One was pretty amazing!
To be honest, I didn't expect her to go toe-to-toe with Oguri like that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Just like Oguri, you gotta figure they came from the regional circuits precisely because they're strong~
Their hunger for victory must be insane, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, well, it's true you don't stand out as much on the regional circuit.
So it's like, all the more reason to give it everything! Ya know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly. Watching Inari One run today, she's way too good to stay only on the regional circuit. It's awesome seeing her shine in the Central league now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That ain't it...! 
I didn't mean it like that—

It feels like Inari One needs
to put a little distance between herself
and the voices around her right now...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, right.
My bad, let's get going—
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—
Inari One devotes herself to training for the Tenno Sho (Autumn). Although she's extremely earnest, she often wears a grim, heavy expression...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, Boss.
What's with that face! You all right?
I can't have you competing with the sky over who looks gloomier."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, Big Sis.
What's with that face! You all right?
I can't have you competing with the sky over who looks gloomier."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! No need to worry!
It's just been a bit cloudy lately,
so I was feelin' a little under the weather, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, you know it too, don't you?
For the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn), this still isn't nearly enough!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The gap between me and Oguri was made painfully clear at the Mainichi Okan.
That's why... I gotta put my life on the line!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Creek—who they say is on par with Oguri—is running this time too, right?
I can't be getting discouraged over something like this!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's give it everything we've got, partner.
Inari One is right. If she can't secure a decisive victory over Oguri Cap and the others, she probably won't be able to claim the title of 'Umamusume of the Year.'

However... we cannot allow Inari One
to run herself into the ground for that.
That is the one thing we must prevent at all costs.

...We must continue to monitor the situation closely.
And if necessary, we'll need to take action to protect Inari One herself.
choice_data_list: (Even if that isn't what she truly wants...)

text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer. As a partner.
I am fully prepared for that—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haaah—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...Dammit.
I'm making Boss worry about me.
I'm so pathetic.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...Dammit.
I'm making Sis worry about me.
I'm so pathetic.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...Figures. It's all on me for losing.
The only way to clean up this mess is to win.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I have to win...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(They're definitely training right now too.
In a realm beyond mine, pushing way harder than I am...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Besides—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(The way I'm running right now... isn't doing anything
to prove just how amazing everyone in Ohi is.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Unless I win Umamusume of the Year... neither my running nor my words will ever prove a single thing...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(And yet right now, I'm...
to Oguri and Creek...—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (At this rate, everyone's hopes will—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...
I gotta eat, but...
I've got zero appetite......

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Damn it...!
The next Tenno Sho (Autumn) was drawing steadily nearer—
